title: Grünfeld Defense: Russian Variation
line: White's queen comes out early and White builds the center, and Black chases the queen with pawns.

steps.text: The Grünfeld, and White brings the other knight out.
Put the bishop on the long diagonal. Once your knight moves, it aims at White's pawn on d4.
steps.after: White's queen comes out to attack the pawn on d5.

steps.text: Take the pawn on c4. White's queen takes back, out in the open.
Castle, to get your king to safety.
steps.after: White takes the whole center with pawns.

steps.text: Move the pawn on a7 one square. It gets the pawn on b7 ready to chase the queen.
Now chase the queen with that pawn.
Strike at the center with the pawn on c7.
steps.after: White takes, and its pawn on d4 is gone from your bishop's line.

steps.text: Put the other bishop on a long diagonal too. It attacks the pawn on e4.
steps.after: White pushes the pawn on, at your knight.

steps.text: Step the knight back. It attacks the pawns on e5 and c5, and it opens your bishop's line.

summary: When White's queen comes out early, Black chases it with pawns, strikes from the side and aims both bishops.
